title: Daily Indexing Request Rules — Phase D (Reactivated 2026-07-30)
reactivation_reason: After 49 days of disable (2026-06-12 → 2026-07-30), Indexing API reactivated with strict guardrails. Initial submission batch: 101 URLs, 0 rejections, 100% success rate.
core_rule: Do not request indexing for the same URL within 14 days. No thin programmatic pages. No URL patterns matching /tools/[numeric-variants] or /scenario/. Never exceed 180 submissions/day (cap is 200).

page_is_high_value.description: Real calculators, real guides, real blogs with unique content. NO thin tools, NO formula variants, NO hash-ID scenarios.

eligible.description: HTTP 200, no noindex tag, no redirect, in sitemap.

cooldown_14_days.description: Min 14 days between submissions for the same URL.

not_already_indexed.description: Already-indexed pages do not need re-requesting. Focus on unindexed or 'Discovered - currently not indexed'.

daily_indexing_budget.reason: Leave 20-request headroom for debugging + manual single-URL submits during the day.

guardrails_implemented.url_exclude_list: Block regex patterns for thin programmatic pages (see eligibility.must_NOT_match).
guardrails_implemented.dedup: Same URL never submitted twice in same batch.
guardrails_implemented.audit_log: Every submission logged to .optimizer-data/indexing-api-submission-log.json with timestamp, source bucket, result.
guardrails_implemented.rejection_tracking: Rejections logged separately with HTTP code + body for diagnosis.

bucket_sources.ready: Pages with HTTP 200, no noindex, no redirect — eligible immediately.
bucket_sources.auto_fix_redirect: Submit the FINAL URL after a 301 chain, not the original (Google has the original cached as 'Discovered' but never indexed the canonical).
bucket_sources.needs_improvement: Thin/duplicate pages — fix content first, then submit.
bucket_sources.exclude: Broken 404 / no HTML — investigate before any decision.

initial_reactivation_report.next_action: Continue submitting remaining eligible URLs from discovered-not-indexed list across next 2 days. Then daily cron picks up new discoveries.
